entries.title: Point at parts of a card on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, tap Point at beside the reply box and tap a part of a card, or select words and choose Annotate. Queue it as-is or add a comment, then send several notes together with your reply. A note you sent shows its part again when you tap it.

picture.alt: Two notes queued above a card's reply box on an iPhone: a paragraph with a comment and a selected word
